coder_notes: Only intervention is a CAR-T cell therapy (excluded type), so S6 = excluded_intervention_type. EGFR amplification is an entry requirement mechanistically linked to the CAR-T target, but CAR-T is not a candidate, so candidate_matched = false. IDH-wildtype is diagnostic only. MGMT methylation appears only in a washout-timing rule, not as an entry requirement, so not coded. Dose-escalation cohorts are sequential, none is a control.
